# xyops_group (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "xyops_group" "all_servers" {
  title               = "All Servers"
  enabled             = true
  hostname_match      = ".*"
  sort_order          = 1
  max_jobs_per_server = 0
  notes               = "Managed by Terraform"
  alert_actions       = jsonencode([])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname_match` (String)
- `title` (String)

### Optional

- `alert_actions` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `max_jobs_per_server` (Number)
- `notes` (String)
- `sort_order` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import xyops_group.all_servers all_servers
```
